# AziHSM Sample - AES-XTS-ENCRYPT-DECRYPT

This sample demonstrates the AziHSM in the following scenario:

1. Generate an AES-XTS key within the AziHSM.
2. Use the AES-XTS key to encrypt data.
3. Use the AES-XTS key to decrypt data.

## How to run

> See top-level [README.md](../README.md) for prerequisites.

Run the executable like so:

```powershell
.\AES-XTS-ENCRYPT-DECRYPT.exe
```

You should see output similar to this:
